sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: "Artists with collaboration relationships" report (`/report/CollaborationRelationships`): the "Collaboration" column rendered empty for every collaborator row. The report shares the exact colspan group-header/empty-first-cell table shape as the `report-multiple-linked` family (e.g. `ASINsWithMultipleReleases`), but its URL doesn't follow that family's `...With(Multiple|Many)...` naming pattern, so it fell through to the generic `report-detail` catch-all, which has no group-header merge logic. Now explicitly routed to `report-multiple-linked`.
